theme_and_archetype.rationale: Wireline is a B2B SaaS platform for fleet management of agents. It requires an authoritative, clean, and function-first interface. We are elevating this with a high-end Swiss brutalist approach to distance it from generic SaaS templates.

typography.instructions: Import these fonts via Google Fonts or Fontshare in the root index.css or layout component.

colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Use #0A0A0A. Use pure #FFFFFF for the base canvas. Color is functional: only use International Klein Blue (#0033CC) for primary actions and Signal Red (#FF3B30) for alerts/offline statuses.

marketing_pages.grid: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12. Gap-8. Use bento-box style layouts for the feature comparison matrix.
marketing_pages.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-24 or py-32 for sections.

dashboard_fleet_management.grid: MODE B: The 'Control Room' Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
dashboard_fleet_management.spacing: Dense, compact spacing to maximize data visibility.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Any container with a border MUST have generous padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.

surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat background, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), 1px subtle border (border-neutral-200). No shadows by default. On hover, slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
surfaces.navigation: Crystal Glass variant. bg-white/70 or bg-white/80, backdrop-blur-xl, border-b border-neutral-200. Must have z-50.
surfaces.marketing_hero: If using a background image, use a subtle gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-white/90 via-white/70 to-transparent) to ensure text contrast.

motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must have hover states. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:outline-none.

components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for crisp, technical icons appropriate for fleet management.
components.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, dialog triggers) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case role-based (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

hero_background.description: Abstract architectural visualization of interconnected glowing fiber-optic wires forming a structured network grid. Use in the marketing landing page hero section.

feature_matrix_art.description: Minimalist geometric data visualization art. Perfect for the feature comparison matrix or 'Insights' section on the public site.

data_center_rack.description: Server racks. Use for 'Fleet Management' or 'Infrastructure' feature blocks.

business_meeting.description: Professional team. Use for the 'About' or 'Team Collaboration' sections.

instructions_to_main_agent: COPY/UX UPDATE (CRITICAL): The current app mentions 'vapi agents' or 'vapi'. You MUST sweep the entire frontend (components, pages, marketing site) and replace all user-facing mentions of 'vapi agents' or 'vapi' with 'Wireline Agents' or 'Wireline'. Do this E2E.

MARKETING PAGE: Redesign the landing page and feature comparison matrix using Mode A (Tetris Grid, Bento boxes). Apply the provided typography and color guidelines. Use the 'hero_background' image with a white overlay for contrast.

DASHBOARD/FLEET MANAGEMENT: Redesign the dashboard (Insights, Fleet Management, Setup) using Mode B (Control Room Grid). Optimize data density, use traffic-light status badges (Red/Green) for agent status, and remove excessive borders.
TESTING: Ensure every new or modified interactive element has a 'data-testid' attribute.
ENVIRONMENT: Apply these changes to the .js files in the components/pages as specified by the problem statement requirements.
